# MasterVLSI

> The best VLSI institute in Bangalore. Design & Verification focus — RTL Design, SystemVerilog, UVM, CDC, IP and SoC integration. Placement in 30–45 days at Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Synopsys, Cadence and 60+ semiconductor companies.

MasterVLSI has been training semiconductor engineers since 2015 from its Bangalore campus at Udayanagar Main Road, near Tin-Factory bus stop (560016). 5000+ alumni placed. 16 industry mentors. 24/7 EDA lab with Synopsys VCS, Cadence Xcelium, Mentor Questa and full frontend simulation stack. We do NOT teach Physical Design — our expertise is Design (RTL) and Verification (UVM).

## Key facts

- Founded: 2015, Bangalore, India
- Alumni: 5000+
- Placement window: 30–45 days after course completion
- Focus: Design (RTL) and Verification (UVM) — no Physical Design, no STA, no DFT
- Modules: 15 industry-aligned VLSI training modules
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 98449 82345 · hr@mastervlsi.com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@mastervlsi2526 (200+ free tutorials)
- Address: 1st Floor, opposite to Vinayaka Temple, Udayanagar Main Road, near Tin-Factory bus stop, Bangalore – 560016

- [Protocols](https://www.mastervlsi.com/courses/protocols): AMBA family, high-speed and low-speed protocol coverage.
- [Services](https://www.mastervlsi.com/services): NDA-friendly silicon engineering services — RTL, DV, CDC, IP, SoC integration, flow automation — for fabless startups and enterprises.
